findings.text: The docstring of `applicationKeyInterpretation_sound` gives the conclusion only as "is sound". It does not name `SoundRepresentation` with a checked reference, and it does not say what that means. A reader therefore cannot check the formula against the text. Fix: write "Then the pair is a {name}`SoundRepresentation`: every database that satisfies the invariant conforms to the schema, and it has a defined observation that meets `contract.valid`."

The docstring of `applicationKeyPreservation_sound` also gives the conclusion only as "is sound". It has no checked `{name}` reference to `SoundRepresentation` and no plain-words statement of the conformance and observed-validity conjuncts. Fix: write "is a {name}`SoundRepresentation`", and add that each database that satisfies the invariant conforms and has a defined observation with valid application keys.
